# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left, with "Welcome - project - Visual Studio Code" in the center.
- **System Date and Time**: "Oct 23 01:46" is displayed in the center of the header.
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: Three buttons are on the far right: Minimize (dash), Maximize/Restore (square), and Close (X).
- **Operating System Indicator**: "Activities" is visible on the far left of the header, indicating a Linux desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: "File", "Edit", "Selection", "View", "Go", "Run", "Terminal", "Help" are listed from left to right.
- **Active Menu**: The "File" menu is currently active, as indicated by its highlighted state.

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Explorer Icon**: A folder icon at the top, indicating the Explorer view is active.
- **Search Icon**: A magnifying glass icon.
- **Source Control Icon**: A branching icon.
- **Debug Icon**: A bug icon.
- **Extensions Icon**: A square grid icon.
- **Application Icons (Desktop Environment)**: A vertical dock on the far left with various application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code (blue icon)
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top.
- **Project Folder**: A collapsed "PROJECT" folder is visible.
- **Project Contents**:
  - "calculator.py" (file icon)
  - "README.md" (file icon with information symbol)
  - "test_calculator.py" (file icon)

## Welcome Page

- **Page Title**: "Welcome" with a close button (X) next to it.
- **Main Heading**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
- **Subheading**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
- **Start Section**:
  - "New File..." with a plus icon and a mouse cursor hovering over it.
  - "Open File..." with an open folder icon.
  - "Open Folder..." with a folder icon.
  - "Connect to..." with a connection icon.
- **Recent Section**:
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."
- **Walkthroughs Section**:
  - "Get Started with VS Code" with a star icon and description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding" (highlighted with a blue underline).
  - "Learn the Fundamentals" with a lightbulb icon.

## Status Bar

- **Bottom Left**: A gear icon with a notification badge (number 1).
- **Bottom Center**: "OUTLINE" and "TIMELINE" sections with expandable arrows.
- **Bottom Right**:
  - A checkbox labeled "Show welcome page on startup" with a checked state.
  - A small icon resembling a person or user profile.

## Floating Dialog

- **Dialog Title**: "New File..."
- **Input Field**: "Select File Type or Enter File Name..." with a text input box.
- **File Type Options**:
  - "Text File" with "Built-In" label and "Ctrl + N" shortcut.
  - "Jupyter Notebook" with "ipynb Support" label and "Notebook" label.
- **Icons**: A gear icon next to the "File" label.

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons are visible in the top-right corner.
- **Window Layout**: The interface is divided into sections: left sidebar, main content area, and bottom status bar.
- **Color Scheme**: Dark theme with white and light gray text.
- **Icons**: Various icons are used throughout the interface for navigation and actions.
